SELECT u.id, u.name, d.id AS deptId, d.name AS deptName
FROM sys_user as u INNER JOIN sys_project_user_link as pul ON pul.user_id = u.id and u.bool_delete_enum = 0 and pul.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_department as d ON u.department_id = d.id and d.bool_delete_enum = 0
WHERE pul.project_id = #{projectId}
AND u.name LIKE concat('%',#{username},'%')
ORDER BY d.name,u.id
select value from sys_config where code = #{code} AND bool_delete_enum = 0
